commands.loop.description: Toggle loop mode. While enabled, the next prompt you send re-submits after every yield. Bound it with a count/duration, or gate it with `--until '<cmd>'` / `--while '<cmd>'` — the command's exit status decides whether the next iteration runs. Esc suspends the ongoing loop; /loop again to disable.
